title: Move gh Transport row into gh/transport.rs with re-exports
summary: Structure-pass job G2: move the Transport items (Runner, GhCli, GhFailure, parse_status, is_transient, transient_text, Retry, retry_transient, clock_entropy, HttpReply, HttpPost, CurlHttp, HostErrorLog; about 340 lines) verbatim from gh/mod.rs into gh/transport.rs, re-exported so public paths are unchanged. No behavior change; audience is the verifier checking the section 5 proof.

defaults_applied.how: fmt, clippy and cargo test criteria
test list diff and test runs
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: G1 (gh.rs renamed to gh/mod.rs) has landed.
Items are re-exported with pub use so no caller outside gh/ changes; private items needed by the rest of gh use pub(super)/pub(crate) visibility only as required.
Docs such as system-facts.md and architecture.md are not edited (section 5 rule 7).

acceptance_criteria.text: gh/transport.rs contains the Transport-row items (Runner, GhCli, GhFailure, parse_status, is_transient, transient_text, Retry, retry_transient, clock_entropy, HttpReply, HttpPost, CurlHttp, HostErrorLog) with text identical to the removed text in gh/mod.rs, apart from visibility and import lines (git diff shows moved lines).

gh/mod.rs declares `mod transport;` and re-exports every moved public item, so paths like crate::gh::Runner stay valid; Grep for the old module path of moved items outside gh/ finds none naming a different path.
Existing tests are unchanged except for import lines (git diff of test code shows only use-line edits).
Run `cargo test --locked -- --list` before (on the base commit) and after: the lists are identical; `cargo test --locked` passes, including the retry_transient and host-error tests.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry for G2 stating no behavior change.

out_of_scope: Editing introspect.rs or the guard test
